metadata.description: Six skills for Claude Code: durable project memory that survives compaction, intelligent model routing, running several skills at once, and keeping an assistant honest about what it has actually checked.

plugins.name: midesparks-skills
plugins.description: Six skills built while running a live production app solo. project-memory: write decisions and corrections to durable memory the moment they happen, with SessionStart/PreCompact/SessionEnd hooks and a generated memory tree. check-first: read the artefact that defines a mechanism before explaining it or handing over a procedure. auto-model: score a task and route it to the right Claude model, then show the routing. merge: run several skills together as one unified execution rather than in sequence. release-audit: verify a release actually contains what you think before it reaches users. layman-explain: explain technical, legal and financial things plainly without softening the real risk.
